tweaks.name: MMCSS SystemResponsiveness = 10
tweaks.why: MMCSS reserves 20% of CPU time for low-priority work while multimedia/game threads are active; 10 is the documented minimum. Small effect, low risk.

tweaks.name: MMCSS 'Games' task: High priority / scheduling category
tweaks.why: Raises the MMCSS 'Games' task priorities. Only threads that register with MMCSS as 'Games' are affected, and few games do. Evidence of benefit is anecdotal.

tweaks.name: Win32PrioritySeparation = 0x26 (short, variable, 3x foreground)
tweaks.why: Popular 'foreground boost' value. The Windows client default (2) already behaves almost the same; included because people ask for it.

tweaks.name: Always start chosen games at High CPU priority (IFEO PerfOptions)
tweaks.why: Windows starts the listed .exe files at High priority. Can starve audio, input and Discord threads (crackles, input lag) and isn't officially sanctioned by anti-cheats (no known bans, your call). Benchmark 1% lows before keeping it. Add games under Advanced > game list.
tweaks.breaks: Possible audio crackle / laggy voice chat while the game runs.

tweaks.name: Allow global timer resolution requests (Windows 11)
tweaks.why: Lets one app's high timer-resolution request apply system-wide again. Does nothing by itself; only matters together with a timer-resolution tool. Raises power use.

tweaks.name: Disable dynamic tick (bcdedit)
tweaks.why: Keeps the system timer ticking at a fixed rate instead of skipping ticks when idle. Mixed evidence; raises idle power. Needs BitLocker off/suspended.

tweaks.name: Keep kernel and drivers in RAM (DisablePagingExecutive)
tweaks.why: Stops Windows from paging kernel/driver code to disk. With 16 GB+ Windows rarely does that anyway, so the effect is negligible.

tweaks.name: Group services into fewer svchost processes (SvcHostSplitThresholdInKB = RAM)
tweaks.why: Mostly cosmetic: fewer svchost.exe entries in Task Manager and a little less RAM. A crash in one service can take its group down. WinUtil's 'Services' tweak already applies this.

tweaks.name: Disable memory compression
tweaks.why: Memory compression trades a little CPU to fit more in RAM. With 32 GB+ it rarely kicks in; with 16 GB turning it off can cause more paging instead. Never use it on 8 GB.
